axis_notes.arms: LeftArm and RightArm share identical local axis signs (-Y = forward, -Z = down, (-180, 0, -75) = up)
axis_notes.elbows: LeftForeArm=(0,-180,85) and RightForeArm=(-180,0,-90) flex both forearms 90deg up with palms facing head
axis_notes.wrists: LeftHand=(-100,0,0) and RightHand=(-100,0,0) rotate both palms forward; (-180,0,0) palms up when arms forward
axis_notes.thighs: LeftUpLeg/RightUpLeg raise forward with -Y (-95..-100). Note: alias LeftUpLeg maps to character right thigh (THIGH_R) and RightUpLeg to character left thigh (THIGH_L)
axis_notes.knees: LeftLeg=(0,90,0) and RightLeg=(-15,100,0) flex both knees backward with +Y
